resources.string: M1 test: pair your printer in system Bluetooth settings, close Hanma and other printer apps, then scan and select the paired M1. This reads its model and status over Classic Bluetooth. It does not print or change printer settings.
Read M1 model and status (no printing)
Requires a paired Classic or dual-mode device
Connecting to M1 and reading model/status… You can stop at any time.
M1 queries completed. See the status report below. Printing is not yet tested.
M1 queries did not complete. Close other printer apps and check the failure stage in the report before retrying.
M1 connection or query timed out. Partial results are kept below. Close other printer apps, move closer and retry.

Test entry: discover nearby BLE devices and system-paired devices, then select your printer to inspect Bluetooth services. This does not print or confirm printer compatibility. Close Hanma or other printer apps first. On Android 11 and earlier, scanning also requires Location to be enabled.
Inspecting Bluetooth services, up to 15 seconds…
Service information collected. Printing protocol still needs verification.
Bluetooth scanning is unavailable on this device.
Bluetooth permission is required. Android 11 and earlier require location permission for scanning.
Could not scan. Wait a moment and try again.
Could not inspect services. Close other printer apps, check the printer is on, then retry.
Connection timed out. Move closer and retry.
No devices found. Switch on the printer and move it closer. A Classic-only device must be paired in system Bluetooth settings first.
Copy this report into feedback. It includes test stages and status codes; an M1 match is recorded only as M1. Bluetooth device names, addresses, serial numbers and raw replies are excluded.
